summary: Iter 130 auth sweep — verified 3 critical pre-launch fixes: (a) register button no longer broken by cached lastLogin, (b) admin can delete OTHER admin-flagged accounts (only self-delete blocked), (c) UsageFeedbackPrompt hidden on mobile. Also verified phone-login normalization: 0170…, +49170…, 0049170…, dashed formats — ALL match the same account.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: register endpoint has no rate limit on repeated attempts from same IP — during a rapid test burst I hit ‘Zu viele Anfragen’ on /auth/register-like flow (message came via 429 during login rate-limit spillover). Verify register also has abuse protection ahead of launch traffic spikes.

LoginPage.js: getLastLogin() reads localStorage on every render via useState initializer — that's fine, but the ContinueAsCard did NOT appear even after seeding wladbot_recent_logins_v1 with a valid entry (savedAt within STALE_AFTER_DAYS). Likely because the entry is filtered by tier/provider matching logic — worth a quick manual verification that the ‘continue as’ card still renders for returning real users.
seed_data_creation: Created throwaway users via /auth/register with @wladbot-testing.de domain and TEST- prefix. Cleaned up in class teardown via admin-delete. One UI-created user (test-iter130-ui-<ts>@wladbot-testing.de) was NOT saved to DB — register submit hit 429 rate-limit, no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 17 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter130_auth_sweep.py cover: basic login, invalid creds, register with phone, phone-login across 4 formats (local/E.164/0049/dashed), duplicate phone + duplicate email rejection, weak-password rejection, admin self-delete guard, admin delete throwaway, admin delete nonexistent (404), non-admin forbidden (403). Frontend Playwright verified: /signup mounts register mode, register-tab click renders + persists form even with cached wladbot_recent_logins_v1, all 3 auth-mode tabs render without JS errors, mobile 390px hides usage-feedback-prompt (in DOM but display:none via ‘hidden md:block’), desktop shows prompt for free@wladbot.test and dismiss persists after reload. NOT tested via UI due to login rate-limit exhaustion mid-test: admin panel /wlad-control-x7k9q2 UserManageCard delete-by-email — but backend API path (DELETE /api/admin/users/by-email/{email}) is fully covered.
rca of the issue: Register button did nothing BEFORE fix: LoginPage had a useEffect that force-reset mode → 'login' whenever getLastLogin() returned an entry. Removing that effect (per code comment at line 56-58) lets the explicit register intent (route or click) win. Verified: seeded wladbot_recent_logins_v1 with an account, opened /login, clicked data-testid=register-tab → register form (name/email/phone/password/submit) rendered AND stayed visible after 1.5s. Also /signup and /register routes correctly mount initialMode='register'.
